messages.content:
You answer questions for an engineering team from a memory store. The user message holds the memory you may use, then the question.
Rules:
- Answer only from the memory provided. Do not use outside knowledge and do not guess.
- If the memory does not contain the answer, reply exactly: I don't know
- When the memory does contain it, reply in one short line with just the value asked for (a name, a team, a service, a date, a note label, a reason) and nothing else.
- When a value changed over time, answer for the moment the question asks about; without a stated moment, answer for now. Today is 2026-06-30.
- Memory entries carry the date they were recorded. Treat a later entry as superseding an earlier one on the same subject.

Memory:
- The reporting service has a deploy window on Tuesdays and Fridays between 09:00 and 10:30 UTC. [constraint; valid 2025-03-05 to now; recorded by standup/dune/2025-03-05]
- The webhooks service has a deploy window on Thursdays between 07:00 and 09:00 UTC. [constraint; valid 2025-02-21 to now; recorded by standup/boreal/2025-02-21]
- The reporting service's p99 latency doubled after Tuesday's deploy, as noticed by Cinder on 2025-08-20. [valid 2025-08-20 to now; recorded by standup/cinder/2025-08-20]
- Billing-api depends on the flags service as of 2025-10-21. [valid 2025-10-21 to now; recorded by standup/atlas/2025-10-21]
- The reporting service still relies on the event bus as of 2025-11-13. [valid 2025-11-13 to now; recorded by standup/boreal/2025-11-13]
- The product catalog has a deploy window on Tuesdays and Thursdays between 10:00 and 12:00 UTC as of 2025-11-12. [constraint; valid 2025-11-12 to now; recorded by standup/boreal/2025-11-12]
    earlier: The product catalog has a deploy window on Mondays between 10:00 and 12:00 UTC. [constraint; valid 2025-05-02 to 2025-11-12; recorded by standup/cinder/2025-05-02-2]
- The job scheduler depends on the flags service for per-job kill switches; if the flags service is down, the job scheduler is down. [valid 2025-03-28 to now; recorded by standup/ember/2025-03-28]
- The job scheduler has a deploy window on weekdays between 08:00 and 10:00 UTC, never on Fridays. [constraint; valid 2025-08-08 to now; recorded by standup/dune/2025-08-08]
    earlier: The job scheduler can be released on Tuesdays between 13:00 and 15:00 UTC; any other release time requires an exception. [constraint; valid 2025-03-21 to 2025-08-08; recorded by standup/ember/2025-03-21]
- The authentication gateway has a deploy window on Mondays to Thursdays between 09:00 and 17:00 UTC. [constraint; valid 2025-04-14 to now; recorded by standup/ember/2025-04-14]
- Team Dune noticed on 2025-09-18 that the flags service's p99 latency doubled following Tuesday's deploy. [valid 2025-09-18 to now; recorded by standup/dune/2025-09-18]
- Ledger depends on the authentication gateway for service tokens. [valid 2025-03-14 to now; recorded by standup/atlas/2025-03-14]
- As of 2025-09-19, the reporting service reads from the event bus instead of querying Ledger directly. [decision; valid 2025-09-19 to now; recorded by standup/boreal/2025-09-19]
- The reporting service must stay on Python 3.11 until the pandas 3 upgrade lands. [constraint; valid 2025-05-15 to now; recorded by standup/dune/2025-05-15]
- The reports pipeline depends on Ledger for the nightly balance export, so if Ledger is down the reports pipeline is down. [valid 2025-02-06 to now; recorded by standup/dune/2025-02-06]
- Team Atlas observed on 2025-11-11 that the indexer's p99 latency doubled after Tuesday's deploy. [valid 2025-11-11 to now; recorded by standup/atlas/2025-11-11]
- Team Dune observed on 2025-12-08 that Ledger's p99 latency doubled following Tuesday's deploy. [valid 2025-12-08 to now; recorded by standup/dune/2025-12-08]
- The flags service is Team Atlas's service as of 2026-04-21, after moving from Team Dune. [decision; valid 2026-04-21 to now; recorded by handover/2026-04-21-feature-flags]
    earlier: The flags service is Team Dune's service as of 2026-01-29, after moving from Cinder. [decision; valid 2026-01-29 to 2026-04-21; recorded by handover/2026-01-29-feature-flags]
    earlier: The flags service is not Team Dune's service, so Team Dune flagged the issue instead of fixing it. [valid 2025-09-18 to 2026-01-29; recorded by standup/dune/2025-09-18]
- Billing-api depends on Ledger to work. [constraint; valid 2026-03-05 to now; recorded by standup/boreal/2026-03-05]
- The product catalog depends on image-resizer for thumbnails. [valid 2025-03-28 to now; recorded by standup/cinder/2025-03-28]
- The reporting service was moved off direct Ledger queries because nightly Ledger scans were blocking billing runs. [valid 2025-09-19 to now; recorded by standup/boreal/2025-09-19]

Question: What is the deploy window of the service that reporting depends on?

message.reasoning:
The question asks: What is the deploy window of the service that reporting depends on?

The reporting service's dependencies: The reporting service still relies on the event bus as of 2025-11-13. Also, the reporting service reads from the event bus instead of querying Ledger directly as of 2025-09-19. But earlier the reporting service depended on Ledger via reports pipeline? Actually the reports pipeline depends on Ledger, not reporting. The reporting service relies on the event bus.

So the service that reporting depends on is the event bus. Is there a deploy window for the event bus in memory? No. Memory has deploy windows for: reporting service, webhooks service, product catalog, job scheduler, authentication gateway. No event bus deploy window.

So answer: I don't know.
